from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper found in the documents, capturing its identity and bibliographic references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    referenced_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the collection that this paper references")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short excerpt from the bibliography section supporting the references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
